title: Opposition Parties Agree to Field Single 2027 Presidential Candidate Against Tinubu
detail: Major Nigerian opposition parties — including the PDP, Labour Party, SDP, and ADC — agreed in principle at an Abuja summit to coalesce around a single presidential candidate to challenge President Tinubu's APC in the 2027 general elections, with Atiku Abubakar, Peter Obi, and Rauf Aregbesola among key figures backing the unity pact. The move came as INEC's 38-day primary window (April 23 – May 30) drew opposition criticism as a 'booby trap' insufficient for organizing effective primaries. Concurrently, at least five National Assembly members defected from the PDP to the APC, underscoring the ruling party's continued parliamentary consolidation.

media.caption: Opposition parties at unity summit pledge single 2027 presidential candidate

title: Pastor, Wife, and Two Children Murdered in Plateau State Herder Attack
detail: Suspected armed herders killed a Christian pastor, his wife, their son, and infant daughter in Gako village, Plateau State, on the night of April 26. Rev. Ayuba Choji, his wife Chundung Ayuba, Cyril Ayuba, and infant Endurance Ayuba were killed in what local church leaders described as a targeted attack on a clergy household, part of a broader wave of violence that has left over 110 people dead in Plateau State since late March 2026.

media.caption: Plateau State pastor and family killed in overnight herder attack in Gako village

title: Davido Performs at Coachella as Afrobeats Reaches Peak Global Mainstream Moment
detail: Nigerian superstar Davido performed at the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival as the only Afrobeats artist on the 2026 official lineup, a milestone reflecting the genre's global commercial breakthrough. In the same period, Wizkid and Tems made a surprise appearance with Justin Bieber, and Ayra Starr won Best International Act at a major awards ceremony, cementing April 2026 as one of the most significant months for Nigerian music on the world stage.

media.caption: Davido performs at Coachella 2026 as Afrobeats dominates global music charts
